programme.desc: Fanny, a housewife skilled in mahjong, loses to Curvy on the mahjong table and in vying for her husband's love. With the help from her master, Fanny challenges Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: The Silent War
programme.desc: After the establishment of the People's Republic of China, blind piano tuner He Bing is recruited for his exceptional hearing with the mission to find the transmission signals of the rebel forces.

programme.title: Trending Topic
programme.desc: Chen Miao's viral article leads to a girl's suicide, prompting her to dig deeper into it and uncovers hidden truths. She joins the battle to advocate for the weak as public opinion shifts.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth 2
programme.desc: Set as a prequel, when the sun was found to be dying, humans build enormous engines on the Earth's surface to find a new home. To save the world, a group of young people decide to step forth.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba turns his mother's chili sauce into a trendy commodity during the pandemic, with the help of the whole family. The business booms online, bringing them unexpected success and unity.

programme.title: Tales from the Occult
programme.desc: An anthology of 3 horrifying tales; a singer spirals when spooky things happen in her home; a livestream ends with an influencer's death; the battle between residents & a creature in the stairwell.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: Hong Kong director Ringo Lam returns after seven years with this action drama in which a cop-turned-bar-owner & his brother are pulled into a gang war.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Li goes undercover to shut down Life Hotel but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As he realizes it serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and his empathy.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: Three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists on dinner together every night, but tensions rises when their girlfriends join the table.

programme.title: I'm Livin' it
programme.desc: Once a successful banker, Bowen now spends his nights in a 24-hour fast food joint with a group of homeless people, with a plan to get themselves out of rock bottom.

programme.title: Those Were The Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set.

programme.title: Break Up Club
programme.desc: Jaycee Chan plays a 20-something slacker who discovers a magical website that may help reunite him and his girlfriend but at what cost?

programme.title: The Way We Keep Dancing
programme.desc: This sequel features the plight of Hong Kong's grassroots performing artists fighting against the government's plan to gentrify an industrial district where they lived.

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: Donnie Yen, Chow Yun Fat & Aaron Kwok star in this classic-inspired tale of the Monkey King's legendary Journey To The West.

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica falls for an online dating app scam with young Joe, who poses as a French engineer. What begins as a romance built on lies ultimately transforms two seemingly mismatched souls.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2
programme.desc: Zhang Wu Ji successfully rescues the six major sects & the quest for the Dragon Sabre continues. After several vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the 2 legendary weapons.

programme.title: Oversteer
programme.desc: Feng defies his father and leaves home to pursue his dream of becoming an auto mechanic. Along the way, he unexpectedly finds himself drawn into the thrilling world of car racing.

programme.title: Bursting Point
programme.desc: A failed drug raid leaves an undercover cop trapped and a drug lord vowing to seek revenge. Senior Police Inspector Li resorts to blackmailing a drug dealer with his daughter to arrest the drug lord.

programme.title: The Sex and the Beauties
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this HK comedy version of Sex & the City is about single, successful psychiatrist Selina and other beauties in search of their true love and happy endings.

programme.title: Find Your Voice
programme.desc: Renowned conductor Yin Tze Long agrees to lead a pilot program training 3 underperforming school choirs to participate in an inter-school choral competition.

programme.title: Far Far Away
programme.desc: A computer geek who has only been in love once suddenly & surprisingly finds himself getting romantically involved with five different women. Will he find "the-one"?

programme.title: Death Notice
programme.desc: The Police sets up a special task force to track down a serial killer who leaves death notices stating when, how and who he will murder. In the process, they expose an even bigger conspiracy behind.

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: A family torn apart 8 years ago during a disastrous winter solstice dinner reunites when their cousin returns home from England, hoping to mend relations after things had fallen apart.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: In this screen adaptation of Louis Cha's famous novel, Stephen Chow plays small time punk Wei Xiao Bao alongside an all-star cast.

programme.title: Burning Blood
programme.desc: A police betrayal has resulted in the death of a narcotics squad member during the arrest of a drug lord. As other team members uncover the truth, they are torn between loyalty and betrayal.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship.

programme.title: Battle Of The Wolf
programme.desc: A former special forces sergeant must protect his wife and fellow passengers aboard a hijacked plane, using his courage and tactical expertise to take down the terrorists and ensure everyone's safety.

programme.title: See You Tomorrow
programme.desc: Each city has their own navigators that help solve relationship issues in this chaotic world. Chen & Guan are legendary navigators, but problem arises after they decided to help a girl named Xiao Yu.

programme.title: The Unwavering Brotherhood
programme.desc: Hua, Fei and Guo are robbed when transporting gang money. When Hua discovers that Fei and Guo are connected to the robbery, he must choose between loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: As a juror in a high-profile case learns that his daughter has been mysteriously kidnapped, he must decide whether to use his special skills to influence the trial as demanded by the kidnappers.

programme.title: Echoes of the Rainbow

programme.title: Firefighters
programme.desc: Based on the Hongje-dong fire accident in 2001, the movie depicts the harsh conditions that firefighters face every day as if it were their last mission to save lives and survive.

programme.title: The Attorney
programme.desc: When tax attorney Song Woo-Suk agrees to defend a student activist who was arrested and tortured into giving a false confession, his entire life and worldview begin to change drastically.

programme.title: Yoga
programme.desc: Hyo-jung is insecure about her appearance. She joined the yoga academy wishing to restore beauty, yet strange things begin to unfold...

programme.title: Oh! My Ghost
programme.desc: FD Taemin meets a female ghost who lives in the studio he works. As mysterious events happened in the studio, they join hands to investigate and protect his job and her sleeping place.

programme.title: Road to Boston
programme.desc: A group of marathoners want to run proudly under the Korean flag after Korea's liberation. Though they couldn't afford a pair of sneakers, they embark on an unforgettable journey to Boston.

programme.title: Sleep
programme.desc: A man turns into a different person in sleep every night ever since he murmurs something strange, bringing fear and danger to his wife and their soon-to-be-born child...

programme.title: The Bad Guys: Reign of Chaos
programme.desc: Oh Gu-Tak, the Chief of 'Special Crime Unit' join hands with a former gangster, a con artist and a convicted cop to solve cases. They begin to hunt for the bad guys hidden...

programme.title: Spiritwalker
programme.desc: A man loses memory and wakes up in a new body every 12 hours. In search of his identity, he met a woman who claims to know him.

programme.title: Montage
programme.desc: 5 days before the statute of limitations of a 15-year-old kidnapping case expires, a flower is left anonymously at the crime scene. A few days later, a similar kidnapping takes place.

programme.title: The Exclusive: Beat the Devil's Tattoo
programme.desc: When a journalist discovers that his exclusive story on a serial killer was based on false information, he fabricates more lies to cover his mistake.

programme.title: Mission: Possible
programme.desc: A cash-strapped private investigator Woo Su-Han is retained by a secret agent Yoo Da-Hee to bring down a high risk arms trafficking operation.

programme.title: Abroad
programme.desc: Taemin and Minji travel to see the aurora borealis. Later, Minji mysteriously disappears. Taemin wants to find Minji himself. The deeper he explores. the more surreal his world becomes...

programme.title: The Priests
programme.desc: After a girl is assaulted, two priests must determine if she was attacked by an evil spirit or a molester.

programme.title: Go Go 70s
programme.desc: Sang-Kyu and Man-Sik formed a rock band - 'The Devils', who gave shocking yet amusing performances under the autocratic regime.

programme.title: A Man of Reason
programme.desc: After being released from prison, a man learns that he has a daughter, thus wishes to leave the gangs and live an ordinary life. Yet the new leader of the gangs feels being betrayed...

programme.title: Hijack 1971
programme.desc: Detonation of an explosive device causes terror in the flight and pilot Gyu-Sik loses sight in one eye. Yong-dae who hatched the hijacking plot, threatens to take the plane to North Korea.

programme.title: Harbin
programme.desc: In 1908, Ahn Jung-geun and Korean independence fighters win against Japanese army. A year later, they head to Harbin as the Japanese statesman Uto Hirobumi is going for negotiation...

programme.title: Sinkhole
programme.desc: As the family celebrates their purchases of a new condo after 11 years of effort, the building was engulfed in a sinkhole due to heavy downpour.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: Yuna is a YouTuber who is invited to a party where she drinks and falls asleep. She is then trapped in the trunk. The kidnapper asks her to do a kidnap live-stream and beg for money...

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Su-young gets entangled in corruption and takes the blame for a reward. After her release, she finds Andy who promised her the reward but faces a bigger force behind him.

programme.title: The Boys
programme.desc: 3 boys were imprisoned as murderers. Next year, detective Hwang got a tip and reopen the case. However, he was demoted. 16 years later, the only witness and the boys return to find Hwang.

programme.title: The Man From Nowhere
programme.desc: A quiet pawnshop keeper with a violent past takes on a drug-and-organ trafficking ring in hope of saving the child who is his only friend.

programme.title: Worst Woman
programme.desc: Eun-hee is an actress with poor acting and she acts in her life. She creates different characters when she dates a man. Eventually, her lies are tangled up and everything is messed up...

programme.title: Decibel
